---
title: "01 -- Import and check"
---

No dataset is imported automatically. Register sources in
`metadata/data-registry.yml` (format `csv` or `tsv` for the reviewed import
adapter) and record machine-local paths in `.cttir/local.yml`, for example:

```yaml
bindings:
  - id: cohort
    path: /secure/storage/cohort.csv
```

Column types and missing-value codes are taken from `metadata/data-dictionary.csv`
when it lists the dataset; otherwise types are guessed and reported. The check
stage reports missing columns, unsupported types, nonfinite values, unmapped
event codes, constant predictors and repeated-unit conflicts without changing
data. These checks are structural; they do not certify data quality, units,
joins or study design.

```{r import-status}
source("../code/R/cttir_workflow.R", local = TRUE)
config <- cw_config("..")
requirements <- cw_requirements(config)
if (requirements$ready) {
  cat("All prerequisites for a study-data run are recorded.\n")
} else {
  cat("Study-data run blocked. Missing:\n", paste("-", requirements$missing, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}
```
